name: Vercel MCP
description: Gives MCP clients OAuth access to Vercel teams, projects, deployments, runtime logs, and domains through Vercel's official remote MCP server, for developers debugging deploys.

skills.name: Deployments
skills.description: Lists and inspects deployments and fetches content from protected deployment URLs you can access.

skills.name: Runtime Logs and Errors
skills.description: Reads and filters runtime logs and investigates grouped runtime errors for a project or deployment.

skills.name: Projects and Teams
skills.description: Finds the teams you can access and inspects project configuration and details.

skills.name: Domains and DNS
skills.description: Manages domains and DNS records for Vercel projects.

skills.name: Documentation Search
skills.description: Searches Vercel documentation from inside the MCP client.
